own_solution.law: Energy conservation: v_esc = sqrt(2GM/R) = R sqrt(8 pi G rho/3), so v_p = v_E (R_p/R_E) sqrt(rho_p/rho_E)
assumptions: scaling from Earth's stated escape speed

defect_reasons.invalid_numerical_precision: With G = 6.674e-11, Earth's stated radius and density give 11.18 km/s rather than the stated 11.19 km/s, so the Earth-ratio route (5.029 km/s) and the direct G route (5.025 km/s) differ by about 0.07%.

notes: Ratio route: 11.19*(3390/6371)*sqrt(3.93/5.51) = 11.19*0.53210*0.84454 = 5.0285 km/s. With R = 3700 km: 5.0285*3700/3390 = 5.4884 km/s (direct G: 5.025 and 5.485). Moon: its pull is ignored and its size has no path to the planet's escape speed, so D. Probe mass cancels in (1/2) m v^2 = GMm/R, so C. 'Before the launch speed is found' sentence T3AA6 and T8A9F both change the planet's radius at fixed density, so R.
